t: No Nonsense white spirit is a versatile solvent-based liquid, primarily used for thinning oil-based paints and cleaning tools. This 750ml white spirit is ideal for professional decorators and DIY enthusiasts working on various painting projects. It effectively thins most oil-based paints without impacting their drying time, ensuring consistent results. Additionally, it serves as an excellent cleaner for paint brushes and other general DIY cleaning tasks, making it a practical choice for maintaining equipment and workspaces.
